scope: entry criteria only; this file does not design or implement the tournament
global_entry_requirements: must cite prior partner-ID lookup and decoder/table negative evidence
must run cheap-baseline-first preflight before candidate implementation
must predeclare transfer, ablation, leakage, replay, and provenance requirements
must preserve no mainline, runtime, bridge, admission, Gate5, or EGO-mainline authorization

candidate_family_categories.proposed_observable: prediction and action under heldout causal partner/environment interventions
candidate_family_categories.required_ablation: remove causal intervention feedback and rerun heldout episodes
candidate_family_categories.leakage_risk: context IDs, transition labels, or generator structure may encode the target
candidate_family_categories.minimum_transfer_condition: heldout causal families with unseen intervention response mappings
candidate_family_categories.not_lookup_shortcut_reason: must require causal update under changed interventions, not repeated key recovery

candidate_family_categories.proposed_observable: latent prediction error reduction under heldout dynamics with action-conditioned observations
candidate_family_categories.required_ablation: freeze latent update path and rerun prediction/action episodes
candidate_family_categories.leakage_risk: latent target may be reconstructable from serialized state or visible bundle
candidate_family_categories.minimum_transfer_condition: unseen dynamics and observation aliases not present in training traces
candidate_family_categories.not_lookup_shortcut_reason: must show update-sensitive latent prediction beyond trace retrieval

candidate_family_categories.proposed_observable: post-replay behavior changes from serialized experience without direct target labels
candidate_family_categories.required_ablation: corrupt replay state or remove consolidation update and recompute behavior
candidate_family_categories.leakage_risk: stored traces may include answer-bearing actions or labels
candidate_family_categories.minimum_transfer_condition: heldout contexts requiring recomposition from replayed state, not exact trace reuse
candidate_family_categories.not_lookup_shortcut_reason: must recompute from state plus observation and fail under replay corruption

candidate_family_categories.proposed_observable: separate prediction of self-caused versus external changes under controllability interventions
candidate_family_categories.required_ablation: swap controllability mapping and remove self-action linkage
candidate_family_categories.leakage_risk: action names or context IDs may directly reveal self/external boundary
candidate_family_categories.minimum_transfer_condition: unseen controllability regimes with matched surface observations
candidate_family_categories.not_lookup_shortcut_reason: must distinguish intervention-sensitive self-boundary state from action lookup

candidate_family_categories.proposed_observable: action selection changes when predicted viability/value consequences change under partial observability
candidate_family_categories.required_ablation: remove value gate or scramble feedback and rerun episodes
candidate_family_categories.leakage_risk: reward labels, filenames, or observation order may expose correct action
candidate_family_categories.minimum_transfer_condition: heldout value dynamics and delayed consequence windows
candidate_family_categories.not_lookup_shortcut_reason: must require prediction-action feedback, not static value-table selection

candidate_family_categories.proposed_observable: counterfactual partner response prediction after partner identity permutation and unseen-partner transfer
candidate_family_categories.required_ablation: permute partner identities and remove social-latent update history
candidate_family_categories.leakage_risk: partner key, preference table, trace order, or query pattern may encode the answer
candidate_family_categories.minimum_transfer_condition: unseen partners and same-ID/different-latent plus different-ID/same-latent counterfactual pairs
candidate_family_categories.not_lookup_shortcut_reason: must make partner identity nuisance rather than answer key
